title: Find the percentage of posts authored by users who have earned the 'Organiz
question: Find the percentage of posts authored by users who have earned the 'Organizer' badge and are older than 25, where these posts have a score above 50 and were commented on by users whose comments contain a website link.

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_026) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(XCL_026) FROM posts) AS percentage
FROM posts AS p
INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
INNER JOIN badges AS b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
INNER JOIN comments AS c ON p.XCL_026 = c.XCL_006
WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Organizer'
  AND u.XCL_064 > 25
  AND p.XCL_031 > 50
  AND c.XCL_008 LIKE '%http%'
